text_block_list.text:
One night, Chairwoman Akikawa was spotted 
cultivating racing turf in her personal 
field.

Growing enough turf for a race all by 
oneself might be impossible, but— with 
everyone working together, they could do 
it!

Fans, Umamusume, Trainers... Many people 
gather and do their utmost to make the 
event happen.

It was undeniably a miracle brought about 
by Chairwoman Akikawa's devotion to the 
Umamusume.
